criterion.question: Are stored items divided, restrained, and visually organized for rough-road transport?

reviews.rationale: The cook station is visually organized with a wind guard, pull-out tray, and prep surface. Propane storage is separate, ensuring proper restraint.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the cook station is visually organized and propane storage is separate.

reviews.rationale: The dry pantry has visible pulls, compression latches, and a divided tray, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the dry pantry has visible pulls, compression latches, and a divided tray.

reviews.rationale: The fridge freezer has a slide tray and restraint strap, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the fridge freezer has a slide tray and restraint strap.

reviews.rationale: The sink wash has a raised faucet, drain, and grey-water tank, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the sink wash has a raised faucet, drain, and grey-water tank.

reviews.rationale: The fresh water container has low restraint straps, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the fresh water container has low restraint straps.

reviews.rationale: The recovery utility has adjustable shelf, MOLLE panel, and soft shackles, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the recovery utility has adjustable shelf, MOLLE panel, and soft shackles.

reviews.rationale: The power hub has AC/DC/USB ports, vents, and cable drawer, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the power hub has AC/DC/USB ports, vents, and cable drawer.

reviews.rationale: The hot water shower has a portable heater body, display, and quick connects, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the hot water shower has a portable heater body, display, and quick connects.

reviews.rationale: The field office camera has a rugged equipment case, latches/ribs, and deployed worktop, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the field office camera has a rugged equipment case, latches/ribs, and deployed worktop.

reviews.rationale: The camp furniture soft goods has a recognizable folded chair/table, rolled soft goods, and contrasting compression straps, ensuring items are restrained and visually organized.
reviews.acceptance_check: Check that the camp furniture soft goods has a recognizable folded chair/table, rolled soft goods, and contrasting compression straps.
